usedFor: Jumpseller holds store customers, and “New Customer Created” fills a template in Documint.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Jumpseller, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each new customer produces a document filled from a Documint template.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” in Jumpseller fires on every update, so the same customer can produce another document.
